resources.label: College of Policing — What Works
resources.note: The What Works Centre for Crime Reduction: reviews and toolkits on what reduces crime.

resources.label: Police Science Dr
resources.note: Dr Susanne Knabe-Nicol's outstanding platform turning police research into short videos, a podcast and courses practitioners can actually use — one of the most useful and engaging evidence resources in policing.

resources.label: College of Policing — Authorised Professional Practice (APP)
resources.note: The official national guidance for policing in England and Wales.

resources.label: Cambridge Centre for Evidence-Based Policing
resources.note: Research and the annual Evidence-Based Policing conference.

resources.label: Independent Office for Police Conduct (IOPC)
resources.note: The independent body that oversees the police complaints system in England and Wales.

resources.label: His Majesty's Inspectorate of Constabulary (HMICFRS)
resources.note: Independent inspection reports on forces and thematic issues.

resources.label: Office for National Statistics — Crime in England and Wales
College of Policing — Crime Reduction Toolkit
resources.note: Summaries of the best available evidence on what works to reduce crime, rated for effect, mechanism, context and cost.

resources.label: Global Policing Database
resources.note: Searchable database of experimental and quasi-experimental evaluations of policing interventions, worldwide, since 1950.

resources.label: Campbell Collaboration — Crime and Justice
resources.note: Open-access systematic reviews of what works in crime and justice.

resources.label: CrimeSolutions (US National Institute of Justice)
resources.note: American ratings of programmes and practices — effective, promising or no effects — with the evidence behind each rating.

resources.label: College of Policing — Research
resources.note: The College's research programme: evidence gap maps, the What Works Centre and current projects.

resources.label: Society of Evidence Based Policing (SEBP)
resources.note: UK practitioner network for evidence-based policing — guides, training and events, much of it in the members' hub.

resources.label: American Society of Evidence-Based Policing
resources.note: SEBP's US counterpart — practitioner-led resources, conferences and research translation.

resources.label: Center for Evidence-Based Crime Policy (George Mason)
resources.note: Home of the Evidence-Based Policing Matrix — field experiments mapped by what they tested and found.

resources.label: CrimRxiv
resources.note: Open criminology preprints and papers, free to read. Also indexed by the search on this site's research page.
